variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Design a substantially more compelling, instantly recognizable playable protagonist PELAG for a painterly action roguelike The War Remains. User rejected the previous looks as generic, weak, and not a hero they would want to play. This must feel like a purposeful lead-character design, charismatic, agile and capable with a formidable signature weapon.
Reference 1: ONLY lock existing humanoid body proportions for animation reuse: exact standing height, head-to-body ratio, shoulder width, torso, limb lengths, hand size, elbow and knee locations, foot/sole dimensions. Maintain warm skin and brown eyes but refine face styling to a self-assured young adult with a stronger brow, focused gaze, angular cheek planes and a subtle confident asymmetry, not a cute innocent child or an aged brute.
Reference 2: previous REJECTED costume/hair. Borrow ONLY the attractive oversized ANCHOR CARRIED DIAGONALLY ON THE BACK, and front/rear/in-game scale review idea. Do NOT copy the old tunic, headband or hairstyle. The hero must have a visibly NEW HAIRSTYLE and a genuinely redesigned costume, not a recolour.
Reference 3: approved game HUD direction, bold painterly masses, ivory highlights, ink-like broad shaded planes, smoky gradients and sparse warm ember accents. Translate its painterliness and elegant colour hierarchy into the character. Clothing must be COLOURFUL and LIGHT, NOT black, charcoal or almost-black. Natural grounded fantasy materials, broad brush planes, few large seams.
Design requirements: only 3-4 major garment masses with a strong asymmetrical upper-body silhouette, visible joint clearances, striking head/hair silhouette, a big back-mounted dark silver anchor with sculpted broad flukes and a heavy real chain. The anchor is ~0.9m high for a 1.78m hero, ~0.6m wide, visibly substantial in silhouette, correct functional short back harness. Its ring rises above one shoulder, flukes below waist but clear of knees; shown convincingly in front/three-quarter and rear. Single simple elegant saber at hip. No tiny trinkets, embroidery, many belts, all-over stitches, patchwork, shiny plastic, literal UI effects on clothing, luminous body, gold filigree or decorative noise.
Animation reuse: no change to body anatomy, no bulky shoulder armour, cloak, cape, long hair falling over shoulders, long coat/skirt, rigid shoulder projections, oversized boots or extra limbs. Upper garment ends above thighs with split hem, original knee-length pants envelope. Torso distinction comes from clothing cut and colour, not a new skeleton.
Presentation: landscape premium character art board: dominant large full-body relaxed A-pose front three-quarter on left, matching full-body rear three-quarter in centre, a large expressive HEAD PORTRAIT upper right and a small isometric GAME-CAMERA view lower right showing readability. All 4 views of exactly the same designed character and hairstyle; both feet and entire back anchor visible. Neutral warm ivory/pale grey backdrop with restrained ink brush edges; confident stylized painted 3D volumes and broad surface shapes, beautiful tangible materials. Focus on heroic appeal and game silhouette, not costume microdetail. No words except option number.
OPTION 03. A bold sea-blue-and-ivory corsair hero. New hairstyle: closely cropped sides, thick dark-brown swept-back windswept crest, compact short tied tail at the nape, a single strong forward-curving tuft; bare forehead, NO forehead bandana, NO spiky starburst hair. Short coral tie at the nape echoes waist sash. Clean handsome self-assured face, slight daring half-smile.
Costume: vivid muted SEA-TEAL short sailor's jacket with a broad ivory overturned collar, open deep V exposing a simple ivory chest shirt; sleeves asymmetrical in cloth cut only, one cleanly rolled above elbow and the other sleeveless with a broad ivory facing. One broad terracotta/coral waist sash as unmistakable strong diagonal block. Light warm cream knee-length trousers, plain brown slim bracers and simple low leather sandals within original silhouette. A single broad brown diagonal anchor strap with one matte silver fastening. Upper-back silhouette frames the large silver anchor. No black garments. One LARGE simple ivory wedge on jacket, no small ornament. Primary identity at thumbnail size: swept-back crest + sea-teal shoulder mass + bright coral diagonal sash + massive silver anchor. Tiny '03'.

A resolute charismatic adult face with strong brows and a calm daring expression.
Costume: beautifully cut warm IVORY short-sleeve shirt, wide asymmetrical open collar, a cropped OCHRE/SAFFRON suede sleeveless vest that forms one strong diagonal chest plane, contrasting ivory shoulder visible. One broad dusty sea-blue waist sash, short single coral folded tab. Warm desaturated blue knee-length trousers, plain brown wrist guards and close-fitting low leather sandals retaining the old sole shape. One wide plain functional cross-body harness supports the huge dark silver anchor. Keep limbs slender-athletic exactly reference anatomy.
